run_autotrain_app_local: run the AutoTrain app locally on a specified port and host using uvicorn
run_autotrain_app_colab: run the AutoTrain app inside a Google Colab notebook with IPython display
run_autotrain_app_share: run the AutoTrain app and expose it publicly via ngrok tunnel
register_app_subcommand: register the app subcommand with argparse including port, host, workers, share, and colab flags
handle_subprocess_output: stream subprocess stdout to both terminal and a log file using a background thread
